description: Does the night after a session with a given tag (log_session `tags`) look different from the night after a session without it? Per tag and metric (sleepDurationS, sleepScore, hrv, recoveryMorning) it compares nights after tagged sessions with nights after other training days, over the `days` nights ending the day before `date` (default 90, range 30-180). Rest days are in neither group; sessions without a journal entry count as untagged; several sessions in a day are ONE night. A metric is 'insufficient' unless 15+ tagged AND 15+ untagged nights have a value; then 'tagged-higher' / 'tagged-lower' only when |medianDiff| exceeds noiseThreshold (3 standard errors of the difference of medians), else 'within-noise'. A tag is 'differs' when ANY of its 4 metrics is; with no real difference about 9% of tags get flagged at 15 nights per group, 3% at 30 (11-22% with correlated nights): treat one 'differs' as a lead, not a finding. It reports an ASSOCIATION, NEVER a cause: say so, and state n and the thresholds. Reads Suunto's workout, sleep and recovery lists and the local journal; writes nothing.

date.description: The day after the last night read, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

tag.description: Only this tag (ignoring case). Omit for all tags.

name: get_tag_effects
title: Get tag effects: journal tags against the next night
